one_liner: E-commerce helpdesk with REST API for tickets and customers

evidence.claim: API key auth via HTTP Basic (email + API key) for private apps; OAuth2 mandatory for public apps
evidence.quote:
The Gorgias API supports two authentication methods:

1. 🔐 Private app → API key
2. 👥 Public app → OAuth2

Using OAuth2 is mandatory for public apps.

evidence.claim: API credentials available on all Helpdesk plans, self-serve in settings
evidence.quote:
- Available on all Helpdesk plans
- The account owner and admins can access the API credentials and create API keys

evidence.claim: HTTP Basic Authentication with base API URL, email, and API key
evidence.quote: To authenticate API requests, Gorgias uses HTTP Basic Authentication with three pieces of information: your base API URL, your email address, and an API key.

evidence.claim: REST API with JSON-encoded request/response bodies
evidence.quote: The Gorgias API is structured with [REST](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Representational_state_transfer) in mind.

evidence.claim: Gorgias ships an official first-party MCP server at mcp.gorgias.com, documented on its own docs site and GitHub org
evidence.quote: The [Gorgias MCP](https://mcp.gorgias.com) is a first-party connector that plugs your Gorgias account into any AI client that speaks [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) — Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and more.

notes: Official MCP server (https://mcp.gorgias.com/mcp) with OAuth, documented at docs.gorgias.com and github.com/gorgias/mcp-cookbook. Public apps require Gorgias team approval for App Store listing, but private apps need no approval and API keys work on all Helpdesk plans. Gorgias is a paid product; 'self_serve_free' reflects that API access incurs no extra fee and no approval is needed, though a Gorgias account (trial available) is required.
